title: A characterization of monoid graded semihereditary rings
summary: Let $Γ$ be a cancellation monoid and $R=\bigoplus_{α\in Γ}R_α$ be a $Γ$-graded ring. It is shown that $R$ is graded left semihereditary if and only if $R$ is graded left coherent and every graded submodule of a flat left $R$-module is flat. Hence it gives a new characterization of graded-Prüfer domains.
